features: Immersive HD Sound with SonicBlend Drivers – Experience powerful bass and crystal-clear audio with advanced 10mm drivers. The perfect Bluetooth earbuds for deep bass lovers, music streaming, and calls with enhanced clarity
Up to 50 Hours Total Playtime – Enjoy non-stop entertainment with true wireless earbuds offering 7 hours of playback on a single charge and up to 50 hours with the charging case
Quad Mic ENC for Clear Calls – Stay heard in any environment with ENC earbuds featuring quad microphones that reduce background noise for superior call quality.
Dual Device Pairing (Multipoint Connection) – Seamlessly switch between devices with Bluetooth multipoint earbuds, ideal for work calls and entertainment without reconnecting
Instacharge Fast Charging – Get 150 minutes of playtime in just 10 minutes of charging. Perfect fast charging earbuds for users on the go.
